attacks.name: Shatter Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage times the amount of Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Wings of the Moone
attacks.text: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Blown Kiss
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Copycat
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon used an attack that isn't a GX attack during their last turn, use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Supernatural Dance
attacks.text: For each Pokémon in your opponent's discard pile, put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Revelation Dance
attacks.text: If there is no Stadium card in play, this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Hot Poison
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Flickering Flames
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.name: Rake It In
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Dangerous Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.name: Altar of the Moone
rules: The Retreat Cost of each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) that has any Psychic or Darkness Energy attached to it is ColorlessColorless less.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Energy Loto
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Energy card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Energy Retrieval
rules: Put 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Hau
rules: Draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Nest Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Potion
rules: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Professor Kukui
rules: Draw 2 cards. During this turn, your Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Rescue Stretcher
rules:
Choose 1:
• Put a Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
• Shuffle 3 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Switch
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Timer Ball
rules: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
